title: Infinite-Dimensional K-Moment Problems in Quantum Field Theory
exact_target: Develop criteria for existence, uniqueness and support of infinite-dimensional moment measures relevant to fields and stochastic processes.

status_qualification: This is a general programme. No fixed configuration space or subset $K$ is given in the extracted sentence, so neither a universal finite-dimensional criterion nor a guessed topology is substituted for the intended family of moment problems.
